useCases.title: Password Policy Violation Detection
useCases.value: Password policy violations indicate accounts with weak credentials vulnerable to compromise.

useCases.title: IAM Policy Changes
useCases.value: IAM policy changes affect who can do what across the entire AWS account. Unauthorized policy attachments can grant admin access.

useCases.title: SNMP Authentication Failures
useCases.value: Failed SNMP auth indicates unauthorized polling or reconnaissance.

useCases.title: Database User and Privilege Change Audit
useCases.value: New users, role grants, or privilege changes can indicate compromise or policy violation. Auditing supports compliance (SOX, PCI) and security investigations.

useCases.title: Brute-Force Login Detection
useCases.value: Brute-force attacks are a primary credential compromise vector. Early detection prevents account takeover.

useCases.title: CJIS Audit Log Compliance
useCases.value: Ensures CJIS systems capture user ID, timestamp, device, and action for NCIC/III access as required.

useCases.title: Criminal justice information access logging
useCases.value: Supports CJIS Security Policy compliance evidence for criminal justice information access logging in Splunk dashboards and scheduled reports.

useCases.title: Advanced authentication for CJI sessions
useCases.value: Supports CJIS Security Policy compliance evidence for advanced authentication for cji sessions in Splunk dashboards and scheduled reports.

useCases.title: Personnel security screening compliance tracking
useCases.value: Supports CJIS Security Policy compliance evidence for personnel security screening compliance tracking in Splunk dashboards and scheduled reports.

useCases.title: CJI media protection and transfer monitoring
useCases.value: Supports CJIS Security Policy compliance evidence for cji media protection and transfer monitoring in Splunk dashboards and scheduled reports.

useCases.title: CJIS §5.13.3 incident response — detection, tracking, and reporting evidence
useCases.value: §5.13.3 requires agencies to track incidents, notify FBI CJIS ISO within timelines, and retain evidence. Automated cadence tracking keeps the agency audit-ready.
